description: Retrieve every global (non-district) TBA insight for a season, or all-time with year 0, across all categories: leaderboard, streak, timeseries, game_stats, and clubs. Each insight has name, display_name, year, category, and a category-specific data object. Very large (about 1 MB for a recent season, most of it game_stats), so prefer get_insights_by_category with the category you need.

anyOf.description: FRC competition season year. FRC began in 1992 and runs one game per year (e.g., 2023 = "Charged Up", 2024 = "Crescendo", 2025 = "Reefscape"). Must be between 1992 and next calendar year.

year.description: FRC season year the insights cover (1992 through next calendar year), or 0 for all-time insights across every season.

name: get_insights
title: Get Season Insights (All Categories)
